notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
Changes:

* Improved mid-air movement
* new loading screen
* tips for all stages
* Fixed some glitches


Thanks for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Changes:

* Reduced Z's movement during special time
* Reduced the number of specials for Z
* Ammo box only adds one special for Z
* Improved lighting on stage 1
* Improved mid-air movement control for Ray
* Fixed some audio glitches
* Reduced difficulty to Final Boss in normal mode

Thanks for your feedback and support!

notes.title: MT Force v1.1 available right now!
notes.content:
Changes for version 1.1:

* Better control of movement in the air
* An easier difficulty level
* Reduced player hitbox on stage 2
* increased weapons damage

thank you for your feedback and support!
